content.what_it_is: Python (numpy/matplotlib) port of the beach_2d plot_current MATLAB script ('PLOT WAVE for 2D CASE' @L1): loads eta_00001 for grid shape (L12, L15), dx=dy=2.0 (L16-L17), builds x/y coordinate arrays (L20-L21), sponge outline [0,100,...] (L23-L24) and wavemaker outline [150,160,...] (L26-L27). For each entry of nfile=[1] @L29 (time labels min=['200'] @L30): loads umean_/vmean_/Hsig_/mask_ text files (L42-L45), masks dry cells with np.ma.masked_where(mask==0,...) (L48-L50), pcolor of Hsig with cmap 'coolwarm' @L54, title from min label @L56-L57, quiver of every sk=8-th current vector in white @L63 with a 0.1 m/s quiver key (L64-L65), sponge (green dashed) and wavemaker (black) outlines with rotated labels (L70-L74), axis labels and a colorbar labelled 'Hsig (m)' on non-first subplots (L76-L82); saves 'curr_2d_wave.png' @L85. The fdir path is a user-specific hardcoded example (r'/Users/Gaby/Desktop/Postprocessing-Workshop/...' @L9 with comment L7-L8 'write your OWN PC folder path').
entities: script; imports numpy as np @L4, matplotlib.pyplot as plt @L5

equations.expr: x = np.asarray([float(xa)*dx for xa in range(m)])

io.name: umean_ @L42, vmean_ @L43, Hsig_ @L44, mask_ @L45 via np.loadtxt(os.path.join(...))

unresolved: os is used (L12, L42-L45) but never imported — the script raises NameError as shipped; import os is missing
plt.hold(True) @L58 was removed from matplotlib (deprecated 2.0, removed 3.0) — script requires an old matplotlib

Quiver slicing @L63 uses len(u) (row count) for both dimensions (0:len(u)-1:sk twice) — for non-square grids the column slice bound is wrong (m != n); the masked arrays u_masked/v_masked are computed (L48-L49) but the unmasked u,v are what quiver plots
With nfile=[1], the else branch (L79-L82) never runs, so no colorbar is drawn in the default configuration; 'min' and 'length' shadow Python builtins
fdir @L9 is a workshop-specific absolute path; must be edited per user (comments L7-L8)
